newsitem.title: USA: Czech Industries investors favor shr split.
newsitem.headline: Czech Industries investors favor shr split.

text.p: Czech Industries Inc said Tuesday its shareholders voted at a special meeting to approve a one-for-five reverse split of its common stock as well as a reduction in the number of outstanding shares.
The company said the reverse split, which will become effective at 1700 local (2100 GMT) on September 10, will result in an increase in the book value of its common stock from $1.37 to $6.85.
Following the reverse split, there will be 2,871,000 shares of Common Stock outstanding, each with a par value of $0.05, it said.
Each five Class A Warrants will, following the split, represent the right to acquire one share of common stock for $20, it added.
"The company is financially strong," it said. "With over $9 million in cash, a book value of $6.85 per share and total equity of $19.7 million, we should attract a new type of investor."
